title.narrative: SBC expenditure showed strong growth from $3.5 million in 2022 to $6.0 million in 2024. The funding allowed UNICEF to reach 4.6 million people with health messages, organize community dialogues with over 6,000 people, and maintain a community feedback mechanism that collected 3,000 concerns and questions and analyzed over 40,000 online and media conversations related to UNICEF’s area of work. Highlights of SBC actions include Risk Communication and Community Engagement (RCCE) in public health emergencies, social and behavioural data generation and evidence-informed programming, applied AAP in humanitarian assistance, risk-informed humanitarian and development nexus programming, and successful partnership with religious leaders.
